situations.headline: Tolu Minerals fully funded to restart Tolukuma Gold Mine via K95m NBC debt facility

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Tolu Minerals fully funded to restart Tolukuma Gold Mine via K95m NBC debt facility (interest 7, risk 5)

thesis.text: Tolu Minerals is transitioning from explorer to gold producer at the previously mothballed Tolukuma mine in PNG, having now secured full funding (cash plus new debt) to complete capital works ahead of targeted Q1 2027 first production. Near-term catalysts include an imminent updated Mineral Resource Estimate and infrastructure/hydro contract announcements in Q4 2026, which could materially re-rate the stock if resource growth and restart execution proceed to plan; key risks are construction/ramp-up execution, single-asset concentration, and PNG operating/regulatory risk.
